Well, no, two minutes.

sentences.zh: 我们为什么不试试那个？

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Katrin Benholt.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的卡特琳·本霍尔特。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, Italy.
sentences.zh: 今天，意大利。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, June 12th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月12日，星期三。

sentences.en: I'm in five.
sentences.zh: 我在五号车厢。

sentences.en: So we wanted to go to Italy because it's where these hard-right populists have gone from being just a small regional party to being part of the national government here.
sentences.zh: 我们想去意大利，是因为这些极右翼民粹主义者在那里从一个小型的地区性政党，变成了国家政府的一部分。

sentences.en: And because of that, Italy is now on the front line, really, of this nationalist resurgence in Europe.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，意大利现在确实处于欧洲民族主义复兴的最前线。

sentences.en: And we wanted to understand why.
sentences.zh: 我们想了解原因。

sentences.en: We had heard about this one mayor in Tuscany, a rising star of this far-right party, the League, Susanna Cicardi.
sentences.zh: 我们听说托斯卡纳有一位市长，是极右翼政党“联盟党”的一颗冉冉升起的新星，她叫苏珊娜·切卡尔迪。

sentences.en: And we decided to track her down.
sentences.zh: 于是我们决定找到她。

sentences.en: So we finally make it onto this train from Rome to Florence.
sentences.zh: 我们终于坐上了从罗马开往佛罗伦萨的火车。

sentences.en: Me, Lindsay, Claire, and our photographer, Andrew.
sentences.zh: 我、琳赛、克莱尔，还有我们的摄影师安德鲁。

sentences.en: And once we settled down and we've, like, sort of stored our bags away, we pretty much start talking to people immediately.
sentences.zh: 当我们安顿下来，把行李放好后，我们几乎立刻就开始和人交谈。

sentences.en: And one thing that's on everybody's mind here.
sentences.zh: 这里每个人都在想一件事。

sentences.en: I don't know how to say it in English.
sentences.zh: 我不知道用英语怎么说。

sentences.en: The problem of people from other countries coming into ours.
sentences.zh: 其他国家的人进入我们国家的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, migration.
sentences.zh: 是的，移民。

sentences.en: Migration.
sentences.zh: 移民。

sentences.en: It's a big problem.
sentences.zh: 这是一个大问题。

sentences.en: So Italy was very much on the front line of this migrant crisis that started building in 2014.
sentences.zh: 所以意大利确实处于2014年开始发酵的这场移民危机的最前线。

sentences.en: You were on the Mediterranean, so you saw it.
sentences.zh: 你们在地中海，所以你们亲眼看到了。

sentences.en: People arrived on boats.
sentences.zh: 人们乘船抵达。

sentences.en: They settled in towns.
sentences.zh: 他们在城镇定居。

sentences.en: There were encampments.
sentences.zh: 到处都是营地。

sentences.en: And they spread across the country.
sentences.zh: 他们散布在全国各地。

sentences.en: We live it all day.
sentences.zh: 我们整天都在经历这些。

sentences.en: Half a million migrants came to Italy's shores in the space of just a few years.
sentences.zh: 短短几年内，就有五十万移民来到了意大利的海岸。

sentences.en: Yes, there are too much of them.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们太多了。

sentences.en: Too much of them.
sentences.zh: 太多了。

sentences.en: I live in the city center sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我有时住在市中心。

sentences.en: I go out of home and I find only them.
sentences.zh: 我出门只能看到他们。

sentences.en: Only them, yeah.
sentences.zh: 只能看到他们，是的。

sentences.en: I think I'm starting to be a raciSt.
sentences.zh: 我想我开始变得种族主义了。

sentences.en: He's becoming a raciSt.
sentences.zh: 他正在变得种族主义。

sentences.en: Vivono in case di lusso senza far niente.
sentences.zh: 他们住着豪宅却什么都不做。

sentences.en: She said that all the immigrant people that come here, they don't work.
sentences.zh: 她说所有来到这里的移民都不工作。

sentences.en: They don't do anything, but they have everything.
sentences.zh: 他们什么都不做，却拥有一切。

sentences.en: And that feels unfair?
sentences.zh: 这让你觉得不公平吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: So this big influx of migrants actually happened a few years ago by now.
sentences.zh: 所以这波大规模的移民潮其实已经是几年前的事了。

sentences.en: But hearing people on the train, it's like it happened yesterday.
sentences.zh: 但听火车上的人说，感觉就像昨天才发生一样。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We're like chasing one hour behind this mayor.
sentences.zh: 我们比这位市长晚了一个小时。

sentences.en: She would have left the floor in one hour behind that.
sentences.zh: 她本该在一个小时前离开的。

sentences.en: We get off the train in Tuscany and we rent a car.
sentences.zh: 我们在托斯卡纳下了火车，租了一辆车。

sentences.en: And we drive towards the hometown of Susanna, Cascina, in Tuscany.
sentences.zh: 我们开车前往苏珊娜的家乡，托斯卡纳的卡希纳。

sentences.en: We're supposed to meet her on the outskirts in this cafe.
sentences.zh: 我们本应在郊区的一家咖啡馆见她。

sentences.en: And we get there a few minutes early and it's this kind of typical Italian cafe.
sentences.zh: 我们早到了几分钟，那是一家典型的意大利咖啡馆。

sentences.en: It's kind of late afternoon, early evening.
sentences.zh: 当时是傍晚时分。

sentences.en: People are having their Negronis, you know, Campari's.
sentences.zh: 人们在喝内格罗尼酒，你知道的，金巴利酒。

sentences.en: And then she shows up.
sentences.zh: 然后她出现了。

sentences.en: And she sort of walks over from her car in a kind of casual, slow way and smiles.
sentences.zh: 她从车里走过来，姿态随性而缓慢，脸上带着微笑。

sentences.en: And looks quite glamorous in that kind of Italian way.
sentences.zh: 以那种意大利人的方式看起来相当迷人。

sentences.en: You know, she's got these sunglasses, these big sunglasses, holding back her hair.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她戴着墨镜，那种大墨镜，把头发向后拢着。

sentences.en: What's so-and-so?
sentences.zh: 某某人怎么样了？

sentences.en: How many months now?
sentences.zh: 现在几个月了？

sentences.en: Five.
sentences.zh: 五个月。

sentences.en: Five.
sentences.zh: 五个月。

sentences.en: She's also five months pregnant.
sentences.zh: 她也怀孕五个月了。

sentences.en: And hovering around her the whole time is her boyfriend, who also turns out to be her campaign manager, Andrea.
sentences.zh: 一直围在她身边的是她的男朋友，后来发现他也是她的竞选经理，安德烈亚。

sentences.en: Susanna.
sentences.zh: 苏珊娜。

sentences.en: Andrea, ciao.
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚，你好。

sentences.en: So we decided to find a quiet place with our translator and get talking.
sentences.zh: 于是我们决定和翻译找个安静的地方谈谈。

sentences.en: Do you know a name already or have you decided or?
sentences.zh: 你已经想好名字了吗，还是决定了？

sentences.en: We are deciding between Marina and Kinsika.
sentences.zh: 我们正在Marina和Kinsika之间做选择。

sentences.en: Kinsika?
sentences.zh: Kinsika？

sentences.en: Kinsika is an heroine Pisana of the Middle Ages that fought the Saraceni.
sentences.zh: Kinsika是中世纪比萨的一位女英雄，她与萨拉森人战斗过。

sentences.en: Kinsika was a woman who was a hero in the medieval times.
sentences.zh: Kinsika是一位中世纪的女英雄。

sentences.en: And she fought against Arab invasion.
sentences.zh: 她反抗了阿拉伯人的入侵。

sentences.en: And she was actually the person who saved the city of Pisa.
sentences.zh: 她实际上是拯救了比萨城的人。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Just to, I want to talk a little bit about your childhood and, you know, go back to sort of the beginnings of it all.
sentences.zh: 我想聊聊你的童年，回到一切的起点。

sentences.en: You grew up in Kashina.
sentences.zh: 你在卡希纳长大。

sentences.en: Do you remember if politics was part of your upbringing?
sentences.zh: 你还记得政治是你成长的一部分吗？

sentences.en: Did your parents talk about politics at the dinner table?
sentences.zh: 你的父母在餐桌上谈论政治吗？

sentences.en: So Kashina, her hometown, and this entire region, Tuscany, actually has a long history of voting on the left.
sentences.zh: 卡希纳是她的家乡，而整个托斯卡纳地区实际上有着悠久的左翼投票历史。

sentences.en: It's where the Italian Communist Party was founded.
sentences.zh: 这里是意大利共产党成立的地方。

sentences.en: Tuscany was called the Red Belt of Italy.
sentences.zh: 托斯卡纳曾被称为意大利的“红色地带”。

sentences.en: And ever since World War II, it had been firmly planted in the left.
sentences.zh: 自二战以来，它一直坚定地站在左翼阵营。

sentences.en: Kashina era una città dal tessuto produttivo importante.
sentences.zh: 卡希纳曾是一座拥有重要工业基础的城市。

sentences.en: And during this left-wing era, her town makes a name for itself in furniture-making.
sentences.zh: 在左翼执政时期，她的城镇以家具制造业闻名。

sentences.en: It was kind of a rite of passage for newlywed Italians to trek to Kashina to pick out furniture for their new homes in this great exhibition hall.
sentences.zh: 对于新婚的意大利人来说，去卡希纳的这个大型展览馆挑选新房家具，是一种成年礼。

sentences.en: But in the 1980s and 90s, things got tougher.
sentences.zh: 但在80和90年代，情况变得艰难起来。

sentences.en: You've got these big multinationals like IKEA suddenly competing with these local artisans.
sentences.zh: 像宜家这样的大型跨国公司突然开始与这些当地工匠竞争。

sentences.en: And people start struggling.
sentences.zh: 人们开始挣扎。

sentences.en: And the industry shrinks.
sentences.zh: 行业萎缩了。

sentences.en: And just when things start to recover a little bit, the financial crisis hits and does the reSt.
sentences.zh: 就在情况刚开始好转时，金融危机爆发了，给了最后一击。

sentences.en: This is when Italy goes into a deep economic crisis.
sentences.zh: 这时意大利陷入了严重的经济危机。

sentences.en: There's a moment when the European Union sort of steps in and demands austerity.
sentences.zh: 欧盟介入并要求实施紧缩政策。

sentences.en: And a sort of technocratic government is put in place in Italy for two years to basically raise taxes, cut spending, and appease financial markets.
sentences.zh: 意大利成立了一个为期两年的技术官僚政府，主要任务是增税、削减开支并安抚金融市场。

sentences.en: And the effect on middle and lower class Italians is especially bad.
sentences.zh: 这对意大利中下阶层的影响尤为严重。

sentences.en: Less money, fewer benefits, and high unemployment.
sentences.zh: 钱少了，福利少了，失业率高了。

sentences.en: And this was a story that was playing out all over Italy.
sentences.zh: 这个故事在整个意大利上演。

sentences.en: It was a crisis.
sentences.zh: 这是一场危机。

sentences.en: And one that never actually went away.
sentences.zh: 而且从未真正消失。

sentences.en: And the sort of economic disruption and that turmoil that unfolds also begins to shift the politics of the region.
sentences.zh: 这种经济破坏和随之而来的动荡也开始改变该地区的政治格局。

sentences.en: But it's a very gradual shift.
sentences.zh: 但这是一种非常渐进的转变。

sentences.en: My parents, even if they came from a family tradition of left, have already started to vote in the North.
sentences.zh: 我的父母，即使他们来自左翼家庭，也已经开始在北方投票了。

sentences.en: Susanna's parents are actually outliers in the 1990s when they start voting for the League, this far-right party.
sentences.zh: 苏珊娜的父母在90年代实际上是异类，他们开始投票给极右翼政党“联盟党”。

sentences.en: And then Susanna becomes the first person in her family to actually go into politics and become a member of the League party.
sentences.zh: 后来，苏珊娜成为她家族中第一个投身政治并加入联盟党的人。

sentences.en: By this point, people are kind of growing disillusioned with the left already.
sentences.zh: 到那时，人们已经开始对左翼感到失望。

sentences.en: And eventually, when Susanna's 29, she decides to run for mayor.
sentences.zh: 最终，苏珊娜29岁时，决定竞选市长。

sentences.en: This was in 2016, when the migrant boats were still hitting the Italian shores.
sentences.zh: 那是2016年，移民船仍在抵达意大利海岸。

sentences.en: And when migrants were still arriving in Cascina as well.
sentences.zh: 移民也仍在抵达卡希纳。

sentences.en: Do you remember, like, seeing it on the news?
sentences.zh: 你还记得在新闻里看到这些吗？

sentences.en: Or did you hear people in your village react to it?
sentences.zh: 或者你听到村里的人对此有什么反应吗？

sentences.en: Now, Susanna told us that the migrants would usually arrive by night, under the cover of dark.
sentences.zh: 苏珊娜告诉我们，移民通常在夜间，在黑暗的掩护下抵达。

sentences.en: The mayor would bring them in, in the night.
sentences.zh: 市长会在夜里把他们带进来。

sentences.en: And so the next morning, these residents would wake up to find that they had a whole set of new neighbors.
sentences.zh: 所以第二天早上，居民们醒来发现自己有了一群新邻居。

sentences.en: But nobody had warned them.
sentences.zh: 但没人警告过他们。

sentences.en: Nobody had prepared them and told them anything about it.
sentences.zh: 没人准备过，也没人告诉过他们任何事。

sentences.en: And so, during a town assembly, some of the residents in Cascina spoke up against this mayor and voiced their anger at the situation.
sentences.zh: 因此，在一次城镇会议上，卡希纳的一些居民公开反对这位市长，表达了他们对现状的愤怒。

sentences.en: They were furious.
sentences.zh: 他们非常愤怒。

sentences.en: But he was very unresponsive, she said.
sentences.zh: 但她说，他反应非常冷漠。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: If you don't want me anymore, just vote for her next time.
sentences.zh: 如果你不再想要我，下次就投给她吧。

sentences.en: And then they did.
sentences.zh: 然后他们真的这么做了。

sentences.en: So this is how Susanna becomes the first far-right mayor in Tuscany to be elected in more than 70 years.
sentences.zh: 这就是苏珊娜如何成为托斯卡纳70多年来第一位当选的极右翼市长。

sentences.en: And now she's this regional powerhouse, this rising star.
sentences.zh: 现在她已成为地区的中坚力量，一颗冉冉升起的新星。

sentences.en: And she's even going for a higher office.
sentences.zh: 她甚至正在竞选更高的职位。

sentences.en: She's running for a position in the EU Parliament.
sentences.zh: 她正在竞选欧洲议会的一个席位。

sentences.en: She said the migration issue helped her get elected in 2016.
sentences.zh: 她说移民问题帮助她在2016年当选。

sentences.en: And she's betting it will help her get elected today.
sentences.zh: 而且她押注这个问题今天也能帮她当选。

sentences.en: And if it works, it means she's right.
sentences.zh: 如果奏效，那就意味着她是正确的。

sentences.en: So the migration issue, you think, is a very important issue in your campaign and in Italy in general still today?
sentences.zh: 所以你认为，移民问题在你的竞选活动中，乃至在当今的意大利，依然是一个非常重要的问题？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我是这么认为的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，首月免费。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能读到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So we wake up the next morning to hit the campaign trail with Susana.
sentences.zh: 第二天一早，我们醒来，准备跟随苏珊娜开启竞选之旅。

sentences.en: Bene.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Is it three?
sentences.zh: 是三个吗？

sentences.en: I asked Susana, what's changed in Tuscany?
sentences.zh: 我问苏珊娜，托斯卡纳有什么变化？

sentences.en: Now, we have many, many unemployed, many young unemployed in Italy.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们有很多、很多失业者，意大利有很多年轻的失业者。

sentences.en: Youth unemployment in Italy is over 30%.
sentences.zh: 意大利的青年失业率超过了30%。

sentences.en: So we can't give some opportunities to other immigrants because we can give some opportunities to our youth, to our young people.
sentences.zh: 所以我们无法为其他移民提供机会，因为我们得先为我们的青年、我们的年轻人提供机会。

sentences.en: Susana told me what Italians tell her sometimes, that young Italians have to go abroad to find
sentences.zh: 苏珊娜告诉我意大利人有时会对她说的话，说如今意大利年轻人不得不出国寻找

sentences.en: work opportunities these days, that unemployment is too high, that parents see their children leave the country to find a job.
sentences.zh: 工作机会，失业率太高了，父母看着自己的孩子离开国家去谋生。

sentences.en: So when they then see migrants coming here, it's upsetting.
sentences.zh: 所以当他们看到移民来到这里时，会感到心烦意乱。

sentences.en: And then she spoke about her own daughter, as her hand was resting on her stomach.
sentences.zh: 然后她谈到了自己的女儿，手轻轻放在肚子上。

sentences.en: I think I have to give to my daughter the right to not immigrate, the right to remain in Italy and build a future here.
sentences.zh: 我想我必须赋予我女儿不移民的权利，赋予她留在意大利并在这里建立未来的权利。

sentences.en: So we finally arrive at our destination, the first campaign stop of the day.
sentences.zh: 我们终于到达了目的地，这是今天竞选的第一站。

sentences.zh: 这条街道200年前可能就是这个样子。

sentences.en: Lots of small shops, a very sort of sleepy atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 有很多小店，气氛非常宁静。

sentences.en: But as soon as we turn a corner, to the top of the village...

sentences.zh: 好了，让我们找到我们难以捉摸的……

sentences.zh: 我刚看到她。

sentences.en: Oh, she's going to give us feet.
sentences.zh: 哦，她要给我们展示一下。

sentences.en: So we see Susanna getting up on this small platform in the middle of the town square.
sentences.zh: 我们看到苏珊娜站上了镇广场中央的一个小平台。

sentences.en: And by now there's quite a few people gathered on that square.
sentences.zh: 此时广场上已经聚集了不少人。

sentences.en: And everybody seems to be eagerly awaiting what she has to say.
sentences.zh: 每个人似乎都在热切地等待她要说的话。

sentences.en: And she's up there.
sentences.zh: 她站在上面。

sentences.en: She's talking about the left and how in just a few decades it has destroyed so much, so many values.
sentences.zh: 她正在谈论左翼，谈论它如何在短短几十年内摧毁了这么多东西，这么多价值观。

sentences.en: Very quickly she starts talking about how Europe is not just the European Union.
sentences.zh: 她很快就开始谈论欧洲不仅仅是欧盟。

sentences.en: Europe was born in the 5th century, she says, BC, in Greece, with democracy, with the Roman Empire, in the era of communes.
sentences.zh: 她说，欧洲诞生于公元前5世纪的希腊，伴随着民主、罗马帝国和公社时代。

sentences.en: She talks about how the European Union actually disavows the values underpinning Europe.
sentences.zh: 她谈到欧盟实际上是如何背弃了支撑欧洲的价值观。

sentences.en: Vienna was invaded.
sentences.zh: 维也纳曾被入侵。

sentences.en: There was a siege of Vienna.
sentences.zh: 曾发生过维也纳之围。

sentences.en: She's talking about European history and how Europe was besieged by Muslim forces.
sentences.zh: 她正在谈论欧洲历史，以及欧洲是如何被穆斯林军队围困的。

sentences.en: Our fathers died.
sentences.zh: 我们的先辈牺牲了。

sentences.en: They fought to defend these European roots and values.
sentences.zh: 他们为捍卫这些欧洲根源和价值观而战。

sentences.en: And the European ancestors defended Europe against those Muslim invaders.
sentences.zh: 欧洲的祖先捍卫了欧洲，抵御了那些穆斯林入侵者。

sentences.en: Today, what does Europe want to do?
sentences.zh: 今天，欧洲想做什么？

sentences.en: Allow Turkey into Europe.
sentences.zh: 允许土耳其加入欧洲。

sentences.en: Let in people and values that have nothing to do with our roots and values.
sentences.zh: 让那些与我们的根源和价值观毫无关系的人和价值观进来。

sentences.en: At this point, as I'm listening, Susanna is kind of transformed.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，听着这些，苏珊娜仿佛变了一个人。

sentences.en: I hadn't heard this kind of rhetoric in an election event like this before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未在这样的竞选活动中听过这种言论。

sentences.en: And the crowd, they seem to be going for it.
sentences.zh: 而人群似乎很吃这一套。

sentences.en: As she starts talking about these battles and as she talks about these invasions, applause is building.
sentences.zh: 当她开始谈论这些战斗，谈论这些入侵时，掌声越来越热烈。

sentences.en: And then she sort of culminates in talking about Matteo Salvini.
sentences.zh: 然后她谈到了马泰奥·萨尔维尼，将演讲推向了高潮。

sentences.en: The man who sort of can save Italy from all of this.
sentences.zh: 那个能从这一切中拯救意大利的人。

sentences.en: And who can possibly save Europe from all of this.
sentences.zh: 那个可能从这一切中拯救欧洲的人。

sentences.en: Europe belongs to the people.
sentences.zh: 欧洲属于人民。

sentences.en: It doesn't belong to bureaucrats in Brussels, she says.
sentences.zh: 她说，它不属于布鲁塞尔的官僚。

sentences.en: And Salvini stands up to those bureaucrats.
sentences.zh: 而萨尔维尼敢于对抗那些官僚。

sentences.en: So Matteo Salvini is the leader of the League Party, Susanna's party.
sentences.zh: 马泰奥·萨尔维尼是联盟党的领袖，也就是苏珊娜所在的党派。

sentences.en: And he's the interior minister of the government, which is kind of like the guy in charge of homeland security.
sentences.zh: 他是政府的内政部长，相当于负责国土安全的人。

sentences.en: And basically, he's doing on the national level what Susanna is doing at the local level.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他在国家层面做的事情，正是苏珊娜在地方层面所做的。

sentences.en: She's actually modeled her campaign style after his.
sentences.zh: 她实际上是以他为榜样来设计自己的竞选风格的。

sentences.en: She's considered to be one of his protégés.
sentences.zh: 她被认为是他的门徒之一。

sentences.en: And he's resonating with Italians because he's saying no to migrants.
sentences.zh: 他之所以能引起意大利人的共鸣，是因为他在对移民说不。

sentences.en: He's somebody who has talked about Italy needing a deep clean.
sentences.zh: 他曾谈到意大利需要进行一次彻底的清理。

sentences.en: This is a man who closes Italy's ports to migrant boats.
sentences.zh: 他是一个对移民船关闭意大利港口的人。

sentences.en: It's somebody who's not afraid to create a real confrontation between Italians and migrants.
sentences.zh: 他不怕在意大利人和移民之间制造真正的对抗。

sentences.en: Salvini's a true populiSt.
sentences.zh: 萨尔维尼是一个真正的民粹主义者。

sentences.en: He's fundamentally opposed to liberal values.
sentences.zh: 他从根本上反对自由主义价值观。

sentences.en: And his name and his face are everywhere.
sentences.zh: 他的名字和面孔随处可见。

sentences.en: Look, there's a big picture.
sentences.zh: 看，那儿有一张大照片。

sentences.en: There he is.
sentences.zh: 他就在那儿。

sentences.en: He's sort of pointing at you like, you know, it's almost like that American...
sentences.zh: 他指着你，你知道，这几乎就像那个美国……

sentences.en: We want you.
sentences.zh: 我们需要你。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.

sentences.en: And everywhere we looked, there was one main message.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的每一个地方，都有一个核心信息。

sentences.en: Prima l'Italia.

sentences.zh: 萨尔维尼是意大利的特朗普吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Salvini, it's our capitano.
sentences.zh: 萨尔维尼，他是我们的队长。

sentences.en: Yes, capitano, it means captain.
sentences.zh: 是的，队长，意思是船长。

sentences.en: In fact, Salvini has been so successful with his messaging that in the time since he became interior minister, he's become incredibly popular.
sentences.zh: 事实上，萨尔维尼的信息传递非常成功，自他担任内政部长以来，他变得极其受欢迎。

sentences.en: So popular that if enough far-right candidates like Susanna win in these European elections,
sentences.zh: 受欢迎到如果像苏珊娜这样的极右翼候选人在这次欧洲选举中赢得足够多的席位，

sentences.en: Salvini is expected to treat it like a kind of referendum by the people and try to force a new election to make him prime minister.
sentences.zh: 预计萨尔维尼会将其视为一种全民公投，并试图强行举行新的选举，让自己成为总理。

sentences.en: This is not far-fetched.
sentences.zh: 这并非异想天开。

sentences.en: So quite literally, a vote for Susanna is a vote for Matteo Salvini.
sentences.zh: 所以从字面上看，投苏珊娜一票就是投马泰奥·萨尔维尼一票。

sentences.en: So after the rally, we said goodbye to all the league members who had been putting on this event, and then we made our way to the next campaign stop.
sentences.zh: 集会结束后，我们向所有举办这次活动的联盟党成员道别，然后前往下一个竞选点。

sentences.en: Oh, I wish we could have to see more of this town.
sentences.zh: 哦，真希望我们能多看看这个小镇。

sentences.en: Okay, I'm going to cut it.
sentences.zh: 好了，我要剪掉这一段。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So we get to the next town, Ruggiallo.
sentences.zh: 我们来到了下一个城镇，鲁贾洛。

sentences.en: It's a cute little place, not far from Florence, lined with cafes, churches, a tiny cinema.
sentences.zh: 这是一个可爱的小地方，离佛罗伦萨不远，街道两旁有咖啡馆、教堂和一个小电影院。

sentences.en: And this town, unlike Pisa, Siena, Massa, and many of the other towns we've driven through today, doesn't have a far-right presence yet.
sentences.zh: 与我们今天经过的比萨、锡耶纳、马萨和其他许多城镇不同，这个镇目前还没有极右翼势力。

sentences.en: It's still pretty firmly to the left.
sentences.zh: 它仍然相当坚定地站在左翼阵营。

sentences.en: But it's this kind of town that Susanna is hoping to conquer.
sentences.zh: 但苏珊娜正是希望征服这类城镇。

sentences.en: We're here to go to a debate with other candidates to the EU election.
sentences.zh: 我们来这里是为了参加一场与其他欧盟选举候选人的辩论。

sentences.en: So we walk inside.
sentences.zh: 于是我们走了进去。

sentences.en: There's a mock-up of a World War I trench on stage, a kind of prop for clearly a play.
sentences.zh: 舞台上有一个一战战壕的模型，显然是某种戏剧道具。

sentences.en: But tonight, the stage is literally set for war.
sentences.zh: 但今晚，这个舞台确实是为了战争而准备的。

sentences.en: Susanna gets up on stage, walks across, and takes her seat.
sentences.zh: 苏珊娜走上舞台，穿过台面，坐到了自己的位置上。

sentences.en: She's actually sitting in the middle, in a row with four other candidates.
sentences.zh: 她实际上坐在中间，与另外四名候选人并排而坐。

sentences.en: And then all of them make their introductory remarks.
sentences.zh: 接着他们所有人都发表了开场白。

sentences.en: And then the debate begins.
sentences.zh: 然后辩论开始了。

sentences.en: And they're covering a lot of ground, including immigration.
sentences.zh: 他们讨论了很多话题，包括移民问题。

sentences.en: And that's when Susanna really comes alive.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，苏珊娜真正活跃了起来。

sentences.en: She starts off by acknowledging that on the stage she may be isolated, but that in the
sentences.zh: 她首先承认，在舞台上她可能处于孤立状态，但在

sentences.en: Italian population, the League is gaining momentum.
sentences.zh: 意大利民众中，联盟党正在积聚势头。

sentences.en: The Italians are with them.
sentences.zh: 意大利人支持他们。

sentences.en: The people the left has forgotten about.
sentences.zh: 那些被左翼遗忘的人们。

sentences.en: They think like us, she says.
sentences.zh: 她说，他们的想法和我们一样。

sentences.en: I'm five months pregnant, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说，我怀孕五个月了。

sentences.en: And when I hear from people in Italy that Italy has a low birth rate, that we've substituted our newborns for people who come from the other side of the world, I get shivers off
sentences.zh: 当我听到意大利人说意大利出生率低，我们已经用来自世界另一端的人取代了我们的新生儿时，我感到

sentences.en: my spine.
sentences.zh: 脊背发凉。

sentences.en: And then she really gets going.
sentences.zh: 然后她真正进入了状态。

sentences.en: So as she's talking, you could see how uneasy everybody on stage was, but also how defensive.
sentences.zh: 当她说话时，你可以看出台上所有人都感到不安，但也充满了防御心理。

sentences.en: The woman on her right is about to blow up.
sentences.zh: 她右边的那个女人快要爆发了。

sentences.en: She's this tall academic who sort of keeps looking up at the ceiling and sort of seems to barely be able to stop herself from rolling her eyes.
sentences.zh: 她是一位高个子学者，总是抬头看着天花板，似乎费尽力气才忍住不翻白眼。

sentences.en: And on her left is the social democratic candidate, another woman, wearing this very stiff smile on her face.
sentences.zh: 她左边是社会民主党的候选人，也是一位女性，脸上挂着非常僵硬的微笑。

sentences.en: Only to then lay into her when her time comes to respond.
sentences.zh: 只为了在轮到她回应时对她进行猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: So one after the next.
sentences.zh: 就这样一个接一个。

sentences.en: As these candidates take their turns, they go after Susanna by going after Salvini and the League.
sentences.zh: 当这些候选人轮流发言时，他们通过攻击萨尔维尼和联盟党来攻击苏珊娜。

sentences.en: These candidates were supposed to discuss issues like climate change, the economy, immigration.
sentences.zh: 这些候选人本应讨论气候变化、经济、移民等议题。

sentences.en: But they now all seem to have one single focus.
sentences.zh: 但他们现在似乎都有一个共同的焦点。

sentences.en: So after Susanna's final answer, she gets up to leave.
sentences.zh: 苏珊娜最后一次回答后，起身准备离开。

sentences.en: Her supporters kiss her as she goes, and then we scurry after her.
sentences.zh: 她的支持者在她走过时亲吻她，然后我们匆忙跟在她身后。

sentences.en: Everybody was saying the same thing.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在说同样的话。

sentences.en: Everybody's against the Lega.
sentences.zh: 每个人都反对联盟党。

sentences.en: They don't have their own ideas.
sentences.zh: 他们没有自己的想法。

sentences.en: The Lega was the reference point of the entire debate.
sentences.zh: 联盟党是整场辩论的参照点。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Every single other candidate referred to the Lega and sort of tried to attack and combat the
sentences.zh: 其他每一位候选人都提到了联盟党，并试图攻击和对抗

sentences.en: Lega.
sentences.zh: 联盟党。

sentences.en: I couldn't tell if that was because I didn't understand anything.
sentences.zh: 我无法判断那是因为我什么都没听懂。

sentences.en: But the only words I could hear was Lega Salvini, Lega Salvini, Lega Salvini.
sentences.zh: 但我唯一能听到的词就是联盟党萨尔维尼，联盟党萨尔维尼，联盟党萨尔维尼。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Immigration.
sentences.zh: 移民问题。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This is what this election is about.
sentences.zh: 这就是这次选举的主题。

sentences.en: This is what this election is about.
sentences.zh: 这就是这次选举的主题。

sentences.en: And in fact...
sentences.zh: 事实上……

sentences.en: The audience seemed to be divided.
sentences.zh: 观众似乎分成了两派。

sentences.en: There were people walking out when Susanna made particularly controversial statements, and then there were others that applauded.
sentences.zh: 当苏珊娜发表特别有争议的言论时，有人离场，但也有人鼓掌。

sentences.en: But in some ways, the clues were actually in the reactions of the other people on stage, the other candidates.
sentences.zh: 但在某种程度上，线索其实就在台上其他人，也就是其他候选人的反应中。

sentences.en: They didn't seem to have a narrative that was strong enough to stand on its own.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎没有一个足够强大、能独立站稳脚跟的叙事。

sentences.en: They kept referring back to Salvini and to the League.
sentences.zh: 他们不断地提到萨尔维尼和联盟党。

sentences.en: And that in itself was a victory for Susanna.
sentences.zh: 而这本身就是苏珊娜的胜利。

sentences.en: We'll see you there.
sentences.zh: 我们在那里见。

sentences.en: Do you know which address we're going to?
sentences.zh: 你知道我们要去哪个地址吗？

sentences.en: Not yet.
sentences.zh: 还不知道。

sentences.en: So we go back to the car, to the next and last campaign stop of the day.
sentences.zh: 于是我们回到车上，前往今天最后一个竞选站。

sentences.en: And this next stop is supposed to be a kind of disco dinner type thing for young League supporters.
sentences.zh: 这一站本应是为年轻的联盟党支持者举办的一种迪斯科晚餐活动。

sentences.en: And I'm really looking forward to it, because, you know, all day we'd been canvassing middle-aged
sentences.zh: 我真的很期待，因为你知道，我们整天都在拉拢中年人、

sentences.en: people, older people, and here was a chance now to really check in with the young people.
sentences.zh: 老年人，而现在这是一个真正与年轻人交流的机会。

sentences.en: Frustration with youth unemployment has been one of the themes of this journey.
sentences.zh: 对青年失业的挫败感一直是这次旅程的主题之一。

sentences.en: And then there was this other story that really stuck with me that I'd heard earlier in the day on one of the stops.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个故事让我印象深刻，是我今天早些时候在其中一站听到的。

sentences.en: We'd met this father of six children who votes on the center-right, so not a League supporter.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了一位有六个孩子的父亲，他投票给中右翼，所以不是联盟党的支持者。

sentences.en: He said he was watching the television news the other night with his daughter, who's
sentences.zh: 他说前几天晚上他和16岁的女儿一起看电视新闻，

sentences.en: 16, and there was this report about a migrant boat that had sunk and a hundred migrants were presumed dead.
sentences.zh: 报道说一艘移民船沉没了，一百名移民被推定死亡。

sentences.en: And then his daughter had given the thumbs up and said, good, that's a hundred fewer people coming to Italy.
sentences.zh: 然后他女儿竖起大拇指说，太好了，来意大利的人少了一百个。

sentences.en: And when she saw the shock in her dad's face, she said, dad, don't look so shocked.
sentences.zh: 当她看到父亲脸上的震惊时，她说，爸爸，别表现得那么震惊。

sentences.en: Everyone thinks this.
sentences.zh: 每个人都这么想。

sentences.en: And he said, I fear that the young people today really hate the migrants.
sentences.zh: 他说，我担心今天的年轻人真的讨厌移民。

sentences.en: That story really made me want to talk to more young people.
sentences.zh: 那个故事真的让我想要和更多的年轻人交谈。

sentences.en: So we get there.
sentences.zh: 我们到了。

sentences.en: It's a small parking lot right by the beach.
sentences.zh: 这是一个海边的小停车场。

sentences.en: Oh, it smells like the sea.
sentences.zh: 哦，闻起来有海的味道。

sentences.en: Oh, it really does.
sentences.zh: 哦，确实如此。

sentences.en: There's a small white building, restaurant, that you can sort of book for events.
sentences.zh: 有一座白色的小建筑，是一家餐厅，可以预订举办活动。

sentences.en: It's a disco, a nightclub of sorts.
sentences.zh: 这算是一个迪斯科舞厅，或者说夜总会。

sentences.en: We walk in.
sentences.zh: 我们走了进去。

sentences.en: It looked kind of like a wedding reception.
sentences.zh: 看起来有点像婚宴。

sentences.en: It's a bunch of tables set for dinner.
sentences.zh: 摆放着一堆准备晚餐的桌子。

sentences.en: There were balloons.
sentences.zh: 还有气球。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So we've just arrived at this event.
sentences.zh: 我们刚到这个活动现场。

sentences.en: It's a big room and it's got Salvini premier, first, Salvini first, all plastered all over these posters.
sentences.zh: 这是一个大房间，到处都贴着“萨尔维尼总理”、“萨尔维尼优先”的海报。

sentences.en: And it's a lot of young people here.
sentences.zh: 这里有很多年轻人。

sentences.en: Not what I was expecting, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实这并不是我所预期的。

sentences.en: No, exactly.
sentences.zh: 不，确实不是。

sentences.en: It's not exactly Italy's unemployed youth.
sentences.zh: 这并不是意大利失业的年轻人。

sentences.en: People look educated and like young professionals.
sentences.zh: 人们看起来受过良好教育，像是年轻的专业人士。

sentences.en: And as we enter, they immediately sort of crowd around Susanna and sort of start talking to her.
sentences.zh: 当我们进入时，他们立即围住苏珊娜，开始和她交谈。

sentences.en: So we walk around the room and we just kind of ask people, what are you doing here?
sentences.zh: 我们在房间里走来走去，问人们，你们在这里做什么？

sentences.en: Why have you come tonight?
sentences.zh: 你们今晚为什么来这里？

sentences.en: What's on your mind?
sentences.zh: 你们在想什么？

sentences.en: We don't believe in this Europe.
sentences.zh: 我们不相信这个欧洲。

sentences.en: We want...
sentences.zh: 我们想要……

sentences.en: There was a lot of talk in slogans of, you know, we want a real Europe.
sentences.zh: 有很多口号式的谈话，你知道，我们想要一个真正的欧洲。

sentences.en: We want a Europe of nations.
sentences.zh: 我们想要一个民族的欧洲。

sentences.en: Meaningful Europe.
sentences.zh: 有意义的欧洲。

sentences.en: Europe where each culture of each nation create a great culture of the great European Union,
sentences.zh: 一个欧洲，每个国家的每种文化都创造出伟大欧盟的伟大文化，

sentences.en: where if you speak proudly about your culture, you are not called a racist and nationalist, but you are called a European who are proud of their roots.
sentences.zh: 在那里，如果你自豪地谈论你的文化，你不会被称为种族主义者和民族主义者，而是被称为为自己的根源感到自豪的欧洲人。

sentences.en: Are you proud to be European?
sentences.zh: 你为自己是欧洲人感到自豪吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But not in the European Union.
sentences.zh: 但不是在欧盟里。

sentences.en: They were talking about their family history.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论着他们的家族史。

sentences.en: Instead, my family, it's in the Tuscany heritage since the 12th century.
sentences.zh: 相反，我的家族自12世纪以来就在托斯卡纳传承。

sentences.en: It's noble, noble, noble.
sentences.zh: 那是高贵的，高贵的，高贵的。

sentences.en: Kind of.
sentences.zh: 算是吧。

sentences.en: And a sense that that identity was at risk.
sentences.zh: 还有一种感觉，那种身份认同正处于危险之中。

sentences.en: And they really wanted to hold on to that identity.
sentences.zh: 他们真的想坚守那种身份。

sentences.en: But, you know, your relatives, your ancestors, wanted to emigrate to find a better life.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，你的亲戚，你的祖先，也曾想移民去寻找更好的生活。

sentences.en: They went to the United States or to England.
sentences.zh: 他们去了美国或英国。

sentences.en: It's like the Nigerians today.
sentences.zh: 就像今天的尼日利亚人一样。

sentences.en: They want a better life.
sentences.zh: 他们想要更好的生活。

sentences.en: It's the same.
sentences.zh: 是一样的。

sentences.en: Okay, but my relatives don't sell drugs, okay?
sentences.zh: 好吧，但我的亲戚不卖毒品，好吗？

sentences.en: Um, they're bringing pizza.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们在送披萨。

sentences.en: Come on, please.
sentences.zh: 拜托，求你了。

sentences.en: No, I'm wrong.
sentences.zh: 不，我错了。

sentences.en: They seemed to be embracing this anti-migrant message.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎在拥护这种反移民的信息。

sentences.en: But there was also something else going on.
sentences.zh: 但还有别的事情在发生。

sentences.en: You know, here were young people who never in their political life had felt in control of things.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些年轻人从未在他们的政治生活中感到过掌控一切。

sentences.en: That, you know, they'd come of age in a time of austerity.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们在紧缩时期长大。

sentences.en: That's all they'd known.
sentences.zh: 他们只知道这些。

sentences.en: That they were now excited by a political option that promised to change everything.
sentences.zh: 他们现在对一个承诺改变一切的政治选择感到兴奋。

sentences.en: And that promised to retake control.
sentences.zh: 并且承诺夺回控制权。

sentences.en: And that promised to end any kind of outside meddling from Europe.
sentences.zh: 并且承诺结束任何来自欧洲的外部干预。

sentences.en: From a Europe that wants to impose these liberal values.
sentences.zh: 来自一个想要强加这些自由主义价值观的欧洲。

sentences.en: A political option that basically promised to restore Italian pride.
sentences.zh: 一个基本上承诺恢复意大利自豪感的政治选择。

sentences.en: And when you look at it this way, this didn't really seem to be about migrants all that much anymore.
sentences.zh: 当你这样看时，这似乎不再仅仅是关于移民的问题了。

sentences.en: The numbers today are minimal anyway.
sentences.zh: 反正今天的数字微乎其微。

sentences.en: It's no longer considered a crisis.
sentences.zh: 它不再被视为一场危机。

sentences.en: This felt like a different crisis.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是一场不同的危机。

sentences.en: A crisis about identity and control.
sentences.zh: 一场关于身份和控制的危机。

sentences.en: And loss.
sentences.zh: 还有失落感。

sentences.en: And an easy way of thinking about that is to think about an Italy without migrants.
sentences.zh: 思考这个问题的一个简单方法是想象一个没有移民的意大利。

sentences.en: So, Susanna, you're all done for the day.
sentences.zh: 那么，苏珊娜，你今天的工作结束了。

sentences.en: You're done.
sentences.zh: 你完成了。

sentences.en: Susanna decides to go home.
sentences.zh: 苏珊娜决定回家。

sentences.en: It's been a long day.
sentences.zh: 这是漫长的一天。

sentences.en: So, we follow her out.
sentences.zh: 于是，我们跟着她走出去。

sentences.en: We take her to the car.
sentences.zh: 我们送她上车。

sentences.en: Tell me.
sentences.zh: 告诉我。

sentences.en: Do you think you're going to win?
sentences.zh: 你认为你会赢吗？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想会的。

sentences.en: I hope so.
sentences.zh: 我希望如此。

sentences.en: And if you do win, does that mean Salvini has won?
sentences.zh: 如果你赢了，那意味着萨尔维尼赢了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think so.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是的。

sentences.en: Because I'm very close to Salvini.
sentences.zh: 因为我和萨尔维尼走得很近。

sentences.en: So, yes.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: People know what they get.
sentences.zh: 人们知道他们会得到什么。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Ciao.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Grazie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Grazie a voi.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Ciao.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Ciao.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Grazie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: Ciao.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Three.
sentences.zh: 三个。

sentences.en: Three?
sentences.zh: 三个？

sentences.en: In America, three.
sentences.zh: 在美国，三个。

sentences.en: Three.
sentences.zh: 三个。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。

sentences.en: Ciao.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Ciao.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: So, we wave goodbye to Susanna and watch her drive off back towards her hometown of Kashina.
sentences.zh: 于是，我们向苏珊娜挥手告别，看着她开车回到了她的家乡卡希纳。

sentences.en: So, if Susanna wins in the EU elections, and if Salvini sees that as a referendum and forces this vote and is then elected prime minister, that would be significant, Italy would go
sentences.zh: 所以，如果苏珊娜在欧盟选举中获胜，如果萨尔维尼将其视为全民公投并强行推动投票，随后当选总理，那将意义重大，意大利将从

sentences.en: from a country with nationalists in government to a country run by nationalists.
sentences.zh: 一个民族主义者参与政府的国家，变成一个由民族主义者统治的国家。

sentences.en: So, we wanted to go somewhere where that's already happening, to see what that looks like.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们想去一个已经发生这种情况的地方，看看那是什么样子。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年

sentences.en: summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我，莎拉·凯尼格，将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.zh: 《地铁》。
